fields.meta_title: Ekisa Kye Ki? Amakulu g’Ekisa kya Katonda
fields.description: Ekisa kwe kuganja kwa Katonda okw’obwereere, kw’ataweebwa lwa bulungi bwaffe, eri aboonoonyi. Wano tulaba Bayibuli ky’etegeeza ku kisa, engeri gye kituukamu ku ffe nga kiyita mu musaalaba, n’engeri y’okukisembeza.
fields.body_html:
Ekisa gwe mutima ogukuba ogw’okukkiriza kw’Ekikristaayo, naye era kye kimu ku bigambo ebisinga okutegeerwa obubi. Twogera ku muntu ow’ekisa, ku mukulu atusonyiwa olw’ekisa kye, ku kabaka asonyiwa omusibe ng’amukwatiddwa ekisa — era buli kimu ku bino kikwata akatundu akatono ak’ekintu ekyennyini, naye tekikimalayo. Mu Bayibuli, ekisa kwe kuganja kwa Katonda kwe tutasaanira: obulungi bwe obw’obwereere, bwe tutasaanidde, eri abantu abaasaanira ekikontana nakwo. Kwe kwagala okukka wansi, ekirabo ekitagulibwa, okwaniriza omuntu yenna kw’atayinza kusaanira. Okutegeera ekisa kwe kutegeera enjiri yonna, kubanga okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, obulokozi bwa kisa kyokka.

Ennyonnyola esinga okutegeerekeka Ebyawandiikibwa gye biwa ye eya Pawulo: “Mwalokolebwa lwa kisa olw’okukkiriza. Tekwava mu mmwe, wabula kirabo kya Katonda. Tekwatuweebwa lwa bikolwa byaffe; noolwekyo omuntu yenna aleme okwenyumirizanga.” (Abaefeso 2:8-9). Buli kigambo kikulu. Twalokolebwa lwa kisa, olw’okukkiriza, ng’ekirabo, so si lwa bikolwa, okwenyumiriza kulyoke kubeere nga tekusoboka. Ka tusumulule ekyo kye kitegeeza.

Ekisa kwe kuganja kwe tutaakolera

Ku musingi gwakyo, ekisa tekisaanirwa. Ekyo kye kikyawula ku musaala oba ku mpeera. Pawulo alaga enjawulo eno mu ngeri ey’obwogi: “Omuntu bw’akola omulimu, asasulwa empeera ye. Empeera gy’aweebwa, teba kirabo. Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye.” (Abaruumi 4:4-5). Omusaala gukolerwa; ekisa kiweebwa. Essaawa we tulowooleza nti tusaanidde obulungi bwa Katonda, tuba tetukyayogera ku kisa n’akatono — “obanga lwa kisa, si lwa bikolwa nate, kubanga ekisa kyandibadde tekikyali kisa.” (Abaruumi 11:6).

Kino kituwombeeka era kitusumulula omulundi gumu. Kituwombeeka kubanga kiggyawo buli kye tuyinza okwesigamako mu maaso ga Katonda; tujja n’emikono ebyereere oba tetujja n’akatono. Kitusumulula kubanga kitegeeza nti okuganja kwa Katonda tekulinnya na kukka ng’ebikolwa byaffe bwe biri. Teyatwagala lwa kuba twali ba kwagalibwa; yatwagala nga tukyali boonoonyi: “Katonda alaga okwagala kwe gye tuli mu ngeri eno: bwe twali tukyali boonoonyi, Kristo n’atufiirira.” (Abaruumi 5:8). Ekisa kitusisinkana nga tuli mu mbeera yaffe esinga obubi, era tekitwesamba.

Ekisa kitutuukako nga kiyita mu musaalaba gwa Kristo

Ekisa kya bwereere gye tuli, naye eri Katonda tekyali kya bwereere. Kyamuwaza Omwana we. Ekisa si Katonda kubuusa buusa maaso kibi, ng’alinga atafaayo ku bwenkanya; ye Katonda kutuukiriza obwenkanya yekka, ku musaalaba, okusaasira kulyoke kukulukutire abazzi b’emisango. “twaweebwa obutuukirivu bwa buwa olw’ekisa kye ekiri mu kununulibwa okuli mu Yesu Kristo; Katonda yaweereza Kristo okuba omutango, bwe tukkiriza Kristo olw’omusaayi gwe yayiwa” (Abaruumi 3:24-25). Ekirabo kya bwereere kubanga omuwendo gwakyo gwasasulibwa gwonna omulala.

Eno y’ensonga lwaki ekisa n’omuntu Yesu tebiyinza kwawukanyizibwa. Yokaana awandiika nti “Amateeka gaatuweebwa nga gayita mu Musa, naye Yesu Kristo ye yaaleeta ekisa n’amazima.” (Yokaana 1:17), era nti “Ku kujjula kwe ffenna kwe twagabana ekisa ekisukiridde ekisa.” (Yokaana 1:16). Okusembeza ekisa si kusembeza kintu, wabula Omuntu — Kristo yennyini, eyaweebwayo ku lwaffe era eyatuweebwa. Obugabi buno bwewuunyisa nnyo: “Kubanga mumanyi ekisa kya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo nga bwe yafuka omwavu ku lwammwe, mwe mulyoke mugaggawale.” (2 Abakkolinso 8:9).

Ekisa kye ky’okuddamu eri omusango — n’eri okuggwaamu essuubi

Kubanga ekisa kikola ku bintu ebisinga obubi mu ffe, kituuka ku bantu abawulira nti be basinga obutasaanira. Tewali kibi kinene okukisinga, era tewali mwonoonyi agenze wala nnyo. Pawulo, eyali ayigganyizza ekkanisa, yeeyita omwonoonyi asookera ddala — “Mu bo nze mwonoonyi asookera ddala” — n’agattako nti: “Mukama waffe yankwatirwa ekisa kingi … Katonda kyeyava ansaasira” (1 Timoseewo 1:14-16). Ekibi gye kiba eky’obuziba, ekisa gye kiba eky’obuziba okusingawo: “ekibi bwe kyeyongera, ekisa kya Katonda kyo ne kyeyongera nnyo okusingawo.” (Abaruumi 5:20).

Kino kye kizzi ky’omuntu ow’omwoyo omunyigirize olw’omusango. Abantu bangi beetikka munda mu bo endowooza nti bagenze wala nnyo, bakoze bingi nnyo, babuze ebbanga ddene nnyo nga tebakyayinza kwanirizibwa. Ekisa kigamba ekirala. Tekibuuza ky’okoze; kibuuza kyokka oba onojja. Okuyita tekuli eri abasaanira wabula eri abo abali mu bwetaavu obw’amaanyi, era ebitabo ebikulu eby’okukkiriza — ebyafaayo by’abasajja n’abakazi abaali bawulira nti be boonoonyi abasinga, naye ne bafuna okusaasirwa — bwe bujulirwa obumu obuwanvu nti tewali muntu ali wala okusukka okuganja kwa Katonda okw’obwereere.

Ekisa tekitufuula bagayaavu — kitufuula baggya

Okuwakanya okumanyiddwa kujja mangu: obanga obulokozi bwa bwereere era tebukolerwa, abantu tebajja kwonoona nga bwe baagala? Pawulo yawulira okuwakanya kwe kumu, n’akuddamu mu bigambo ebitaliimu kubuusabuusa: “Tweyongere okwonoona, olwo ekisa kya Katonda kiryoke kyeyongere? Kikafuuwe” (Abaruumi 6:1-2). Ekisa tekitulekera we kitusanze. Ekisa kye kimu ekisonyiwa era kikyusa; si kusalawo kwokka kw’omusango wabula maanyi. “Kubanga ekisa kya Katonda ekireetera abantu bonna obulokozi kirabise, era kituyigiriza tuleke obutatya Katonda, n’okwegomba kw’ensi, tulyoke tube beegendereza, abatuukirivu abatya Katonda nga tuli mu mulembe gwa kaakano” (Tito 2:11-12).

Ekisa ekya ddala kireeta okwebaza, n’okwebaza ne kuleeta obuwulize — si buwulize obw’okwemulugunya obw’omuddu agezaako okufuna empeera, wabula obuwulize obw’essanyu obw’omwana eyagalibwa edda. Pawulo bwe yayogera ku kufuba kwe okutakoowa, yeegendereza okulaga gye kwava: “nakola nnyo okusinga abalala bonna, naye si nze nakola wabula ekisa kya Katonda ekiri nange kye kyakola.” (1 Abakkolinso 15:10). Ekisa tekiwakanya kufuba; kiwakanya kugezaako kukifuna lwa mpeera. Kituwa amaanyi okukola obuwulize obwo bwennyini bwe kitasaba ng’akakwakkulizo.

Ekisa kitufuula ba kisa

Ekisa ekisembezeddwa tekiyinza kusigala nga kyakyama; kikyusa engeri gye tuyisaamu buli muntu omulala. Bwe tumala okusonyiyibwa ebbanja eritasasulika, tetuyinza kwesibira ku mabanja amatono abalala ge batubanja. Eyo ye nsonga y’olugero lwa Yesu olw’omuddu ataasonyiwa, eyasonyiyibwa obukadde n’obukadde, n’alyoka anyiga omusajja ensingo olw’obusente obutono — kulabula nti ekisa ekikwekebwa kiba ekisa ekitategeereddwa ddala. Pawulo agatta butereevu omusaalaba n’empisa zaffe: “Mubenga ba kisa, buli omu alumirwenga munne, era musonyiwaganenga, nga Katonda bwe yabasonyiwa mu Kristo.” (Abaefeso 4:32), era nate, “Nga Mukama waffe bwe yabasonyiwa era nammwe musonyiwaganenga.” (Abakkolosaayi 3:13).

Kale ekikakasa oba ddala tutegedde ekisa si bwe tusobola okukinnyonnyola mu bigambo ebirungi, wabula bwe tukigaba mu ddembe — nga bwe tugumiikiriza abagwa, bwe tugaba eri abatasaanira, era bwe tusonyiwa amangu. Omukristaayo omukodo, asalira abalala emisango, era anyiiga amangu, yeerabidde obungi bw’ebyamusonyiyibwa. Ow’ekisa akyajjukira. Ekisa kikulukuta okuva ku musaalaba, ne kiyita mu ffe, ne kituuka ku nsi etutunuulidde; gye kituuse ddala, bulijjo kiyitirira.

Ekisa kimala buli bunafu

Ekisa si kye kyokka kye tutandikisa obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo; kye tubeeza mu buli lunaku lwabwo. Pawulo bwe yeegayirira eriggwa liggyibweko, Katonda n’atariggyako, eky’okuddamu kye yafuna kinywezezza abantu bangi abali mu kubonaabona okuva olwo: “Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.” (2 Abakkolinso 12:9). Ekisa tekikyusa bulijjo mbeera zaffe, naye bulijjo kitusisinkana mu zo, nga kituwa ddala ekyo ekiseera kye kyetaaga. Waliwo ekisa ku kitanda ky’okufa, ekisa mu kumalibwamu amaanyi, ekisa mu mirimu egya buli lunaku — era entebe gye tusemberera okukifuna, mu bigambo ebitegeerekeka, ye “entebe ya Katonda ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa”, gye “tufune okusaasirwa n’ekisa tubeerwe mu kwetaaga kwaffe” (Abaebbulaniya 4:16).

Eno y’ensonga lwaki obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo, bwe butegeerwa obulungi, bwa kisa okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero: ekisa okulokola, ekisa okutukuza, ekisa okuwanirira, era ku nkomerero ekisa okututwala eka. Tutukuzibwa lwa kisa, kubanga “Bwe tulimala okutukuzibwa olw’ekisa kye, tulyoke tufune omugabo mu kusuubira obulamu obutaggwaawo” (Tito 3:7); tuyimiridde mu kisa, kubanga “olw’okukkiriza mu Kristo tufunye ekisa kya Katonda mwe tubeera” (Abaruumi 5:2); era olunaku lumu tuliwuniikirira bwe tulirabira ddala “ekisa kye ekingi kye yatukwatirwa mu Kristo Yesu” (Abaefeso 2:7).

Engeri y’okukisembeza

Obanga ekisa kirabo, olwo tekiyinza kufunibwa lwa mpeera, wabula kusembezebwa kwokka — era okusembeza kye kintu kimu kyokka omuntu alina emikono ebyereere ky’asobola okukola. Tosooka kwefuula asaanira; ojja nga bw’oli, ng’okkiriza Kristo, era ekirabo ne kiba kikyo. Ekyo kye kyesittaza era kye kitiibwa ky’ekisa: tekitusaba kintu kyonna okuggyako okulekera awo okugezaako okusasula, ne tutwala butwazi ekyo Katonda ky’agaba ku bwereere.

Oboolyawo omaze emyaka mingi ng’ogezaako okuba omulungi ekimala eri Katonda, era gy’okoma okufuba, gy’akoma okulabika ng’ali wala. Ekisa kikomya okubalirira okwo okukooya. Kikubuulira nti ebbanja lyasasulwa dda, okwaniriza kwategekebwa dda, era Kitaffe adduka dda okukusisinkana ng’okyali wala. Tewali kirala kisigaddeyo okuggyako okujja. “ekirabo kya Katonda, bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.” (Abaruumi 6:23) — era ekirabo, okuba ekirabo, kyetaaga kusembezebwa busembezebwa. Onookisembeza leero?

qa.question: Ekisa kye ki ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bikinnyonnyola?
qa.answer: Ekisa kwe kuganja kwa Katonda kwe tutasaanira: obulungi bwe obw’obwereere, bwe tutasaanidde, eri abantu abaasaanira ekikontana nakwo. Pawulo akinnyonnyola mu bigambo ebitegeerekeka: “Mwalokolebwa lwa kisa olw’okukkiriza. Tekwava mu mmwe, wabula kirabo kya Katonda. Tekwatuweebwa lwa bikolwa byaffe; noolwekyo omuntu yenna aleme okwenyumirizanga.” (Abaefeso 2:8-9).

qa.question: Ekisa kya bwereere?
qa.answer: Ekisa kya bwereere gye tuli, naye eri Katonda tekyali kya bwereere; kyamuwaza Omwana we. Katonda tabuusa buusa maaso kibi ng’alinga atafaayo ku bwenkanya. Yatuukiriza obwenkanya yekka ku musaalaba, okusaasira kulyoke kukulukutire abazzi b’emisango: “twaweebwa obutuukirivu bwa buwa olw’ekisa kye ekiri mu kununulibwa okuli mu Yesu Kristo” (Abaruumi 3:24).

qa.question: Omuntu ayinza okuba omwonoonyi ennyo ekisa kya Katonda ne kitamutuukako?
qa.answer: Tewali kibi kinene okukisinga, era tewali mwonoonyi agenze wala nnyo. Pawulo yali ayigganyizza ekkanisa era n’alyoka yeeyita omwonoonyi asookera ddala, naye n’awandiika nti “Mukama waffe yankwatirwa ekisa kingi n’ampa okukkiriza kungi” (1 Timoseewo 1:14). Ekibi gye kyeyongera, ekisa gye kyeyongera ennyo okusingawo. Ekisa tekibuuza ky’okoze, kibuuza kyokka oba onojja.

qa.question: Obanga obulokozi bwa kisa, Abakristaayo bayinza okweyongera okwonoona?
qa.answer: Pawulo yaddamu okuwakanya okwo mu bigambo ebitaliimu kubuusabuusa: “Kikafuuwe” (Abaruumi 6:1-2). Ekisa ekisonyiwa era kikyusa; kituyigiriza “tuleke obutatya Katonda” (Tito 2:11-12). Ekisa ekya ddala kireeta okwebaza, n’okwebaza ne kuleeta obuwulize obw’essanyu. Ekisa tekiwakanya kufuba; kiwakanya kugezaako kukifuna lwa mpeera.

qa.question: Osembeza otya ekisa kya Katonda?
qa.answer: Kubanga kirabo, tekiyinza kufunibwa lwa mpeera, wabula kusembezebwa kwokka. Tosooka kwefuula asaanira; ojja nga bw’oli, ng’okkiriza Kristo, era ekirabo ne kiba kikyo. Ekisa kikomya okubalirira okukooya okw’okugezaako okuba omulungi ekimala: ebbanja lyasasulwa dda, n’okwaniriza kwategekebwa dda.
